patches.name: Add archive links to the post menu
patches.description: Adds Wayback Machine and archive.today options to the menu behind a post's overflow button, next to "Open in browser". Useful for reading a page that has since been taken down or put behind a paywall.

patches.name: Automatically undelete Imgur images
patches.description: Loads Imgur images that no longer exist from the Wayback Machine. Imgur removed a large amount of older content, so links in old posts often fail. Only images the archive happens to hold can be recovered.

patches.name: Automatically undelete Reddit content
patches.description: Restores the text of removed posts and comments from Project Arctic Shift. Restored text is marked to show why it was taken down. Only text can be recovered, and only where the archive has it.

patches.name: Disable Sync for Lemmy bottom sheet
patches.description: Disables the bottom sheet at the startup that asks you to signup to "Sync for Lemmy".

patches.name: Enable Android debugging
patches.description: Enables Android developer debugging capabilities. Including this patch can slow down the app.

patches.name: Fix Imgur links
patches.description: Sync resolves Imgur links through a proxy of its own that no longer exists, so they fail to load. Answers those requests locally instead. Album contents are read from an archived copy of the album page, which only works for albums the archive captured while Imgur still rendered them.

patches.name: Fix post thumbnails
patches.description: Fixes loading post thumbnails by correcting their URLs.

patches.name: Fix video downloads
patches.description: Fixes a bug in Sync's MPD parser resulting in only the audio-track being saved.

patches.name: Modify login WebView
patches.description: Modify the WebView used for logging into reddit to prevent login issues

patches.name: Redirect Gfycat links to RedGifs
patches.description: Answers Gfycat requests from RedGifs, which hosts much of the content that moved there before Gfycat shut down. Gfycat's domains no longer resolve, so without this every Gfycat link fails to load.

patches.name: Spoof client
patches.description: Restores functionality of the app by using custom client ID.

options.title: OAuth client ID
options.description: The Reddit OAuth client ID. Refer to Sync Up documentation for more information on what to put here.

options.title: Redirect URI
options.description: The Reddit OAuth redirect URI. Refer to Sync Up documentation for more information on what to put here. Default value is RedReader's redirect URI.

options.title: User agent
options.description: The app's user agent. Refer to Sync Up documentation for more information on what to put here. Default value is RedReader's user agent.

patches.name: Use /user/ endpoint
patches.description: Replaces the deprecated endpoint for viewing user profiles /u with /user, that used to fix a bug.
